description: Enqueue a URL for Yandex re-crawl. Daily quota applies (check get-recrawl-quota). Returns task_id. Use when the user asks Yandex to recrawl one URL and the daily quota still has room. Do not use it to check the quota first; call get-recrawl-quota. Do not use it to read a task later; call get-recrawl-task with the returned task id.

url.description: Full URL on the host to re-crawl (must start with host scheme+domain)

name: add-recrawl-url
title: Queue URL for re-crawl
